synthetic_positive: service.schema 3 reconciles every declared external input exactly once under declared material rules, reports excluded unsuitable and water mass, and binds rules and inputs to opened local extracts in a newly signed materials payload.

Changed coefficient, uncertainty, material, classification or input mass against fixed opened extracts is rejected even after local digest recalculation.
Missing, duplicate or cross-period external inputs are rejected; coproduct output is not counted twice.
A new signed attestation fails without both rule-approval and input-source byte binding.
independent_read_only_review: No blocking criterion-3 false approval was reproduced; a coordinated fabrication of rules, inputs and new extracts can still pass as a declared ceiling and requires a new signature.
